how-flip.page: Tap or click each card to flip it and read what the word means. Tap 🔊 to hear the word.
how-flip.say: Tap or click each card to flip it and read what the word means. Tap the speaker to hear the word.

how-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the rock, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the rock, then tap three things you notice.

how-order.page: Drag each photo into the film strip, from first to last. You can also tap a photo, then tap a frame. Get the order right and your strip becomes a movie.
how-order.say: Drag each photo into the film strip, from first to last. You can also tap a photo, then tap a frame. Get the order right and your strip becomes a movie.

how-compare.page: Follow the steps one at a time. You will pick, test, and then explain.
how-compare.say: Follow the steps one at a time. You will pick, test, and then explain.

how-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing layer: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the fossil shows.
how-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing layer: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the fossil shows.

how-detective.page: Pick 3 cards, one at a time. For each one, tap a clue you see and pick what it was. Then predict where it lived and watch the past appear. Your answers fill the chart.
how-detective.say: Pick three cards, one at a time. For each one, tap a clue you see and pick what it was. Then predict where it lived and watch the past appear. Your answers fill the chart.

how-rebuild.page: Pick one you solved. Pick the place it points to, then pick the living things that belong there.
how-rebuild.say: Pick one you solved. Pick the place it points to, then pick the living things that belong there.

how-parta.page: Read each one. Pick the best answer, or type your answer.
how-parta.say: Read each one. Pick the best answer, or type your answer.

how-partb.page: Answer in complete sentences. Use your science words.
how-partb.say: Answer in complete sentences. Use your science words.

how-write-1.page: Pick one from your evidence chart. Answer the three questions. Use at least one of the science words under the boxes.
how-write-1.say: Pick one from your evidence chart. Answer the three questions. Use at least one of the science words under the boxes.

how-write-2.page: Pick one from your evidence chart. Answer the three questions. Use at least two of the science words under the boxes.
how-write-2.say: Pick one from your evidence chart. Answer the three questions. Use at least two of the science words under the boxes.

how-checklist.page: Tap each item when it is done. Items you finish on the page check themselves.
how-checklist.say: Tap each item when it is done. Items you finish on the page check themselves.

how-premiere.page: Check your exhibit. Pick the one you wrote about, add your first name, then press Premiere film.
how-premiere.say: Check your exhibit. Pick the one you wrote about, add your first name, then press Premiere film.

how-specimen-plant.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the plant, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-specimen-plant.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the plant, then tap three things you notice.

how-wall-plant.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing layer: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the plant shows.
how-wall-plant.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing layer: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the plant shows.

how-detective-plant.page: Pick 3 cards, one at a time. Tap a clue you see, then pick what it is. Predict where it grows, and watch its home appear.
how-detective-plant.say: Pick three cards, one at a time. Tap a clue you see, then pick what it is. Predict where it grows, and watch its home appear.
